messages:
inc-bot: [ALERT] high-5xx-rate detected for tenant=harbormed (dedicated-vpc pool: dvp-08). 5m error rate spike to 12% > threshold 5%. Paging on-call.

bjorn-oncall: acked. I'm pulling logs and metrics now. tagging @tammy-sre for immediate help.

tammy-sre: on it. seeing a sudden surge in model-inference errors around 2023-12-08T14:02Z — `kv-cache-mismatch` and a handful of OOMs on instances in dvp-08-canary. Canary subset is ~3% of traffic for harborMed.

devin-platform: adding context — we rolled artifact r2023.12.08-phi12 to canary at 13:55Z with quantized runtime changes. Only HarborMed's dedicated pool and one other small internal test pool got it.

alicia-support: FYI customer-CS has reported timeouts in their app (no user data loss reported). They asked if this is related to today's canary. I told them we're investigating and routing traffic to stable if needed.

bjorn-oncall: current impact: 3% canary of HarborMed traffic experiencing ~500s and RPC errors. Global traffic unaffected. SLOs for HarborMed degraded. I'm proposing immediate surgical rollback of canary artifact for dvp-08 and pin the stable artifact while we root cause.

elaine-pm: agree — customer priority is low-latency availability. Please coordinate rollback and notify customer once done. Keep me posted on ETA.

tammy-sre: plan: 1) divert HarborMed canary traffic to stable flavor (no full pool restart), 2) pin artifact r2023.11.30-ga4 on dvp-08, 3) keep canary instances isolated for postmortem logs. I'll run the commands and monitor.

devin-platform: commands ready. rolling traffic divert via routing policies:

```
# divert harborMed canary -> stable flavor
redwoodctl route update --pool dvp-08 --tenant harbormed --traffic-canary 0 --traffic-stable 100

# pin stable artifact on dvp-08
redwoodctl artifact pin --pool dvp-08 --artifact r2023.11.30-ga4 --reason "emergency rollback: inference errors"

```

tammy-sre: executing now (will post progress). @bjorn-oncall, you'll have handoff if I need support after 14:10Z.

inc-bot: deploy-bot: routing-change initiated by tammy-sre for pool=dvp-08 tenant=harbormed; request_id=db-3161723468

tammy-sre: routing update applied. canary->stable traffic shift completed at 14:03:42Z. pin command running...

inc-bot: artifact-service: pin request accepted artifact=r2023.11.30-ga4 pool=dvp-08 status=queued

tammy-sre: pin completed at 14:04:10Z. Verified pool is serving pinned artifact r2023.11.30-ga4. Now watching error rate.

devin-platform: metrics showing 5xx rate dropping to 1.1% in the next 90s. latency back to baseline. Good sign.

alicia-support: drafting customer update: "We've diverted traffic back to the previously stable model and pinned the stable artifact while we investigate a regression in the canary artifact. No data loss; we're monitoring closely and will follow up with a detailed timeline." Want me to send now?

bjorn-oncall: yes please send now. cc @elaine-pm. Also create a short incident ticket and assign to tammy and devin for postmortem.

elaine-pm: adding to roadmap for root cause check and decision on reintroducing phi12 after fixes.

ops-lead: quick note — capture kernel logs and any LD_PRELOAD or lib mismatch on canary nodes. suspect runtime kernel compatibility with quantization flags.

tammy-sre: noted. snapshotting canary nodes and exporting logs to secure bucket now. I'll post links once available.

tammy-sre: postmortem ticket created: INC-2023-1212-harbor-canary-regression. Assigning tammy-sre and devin-platform. ETA for initial RCA: 48 hours.

inc-bot: incident closed (mitigated) by tammy-sre at 14:10:48Z. followup required: yes. severity: P2.
